description: Answer a question about a business from its Foundry ontology, with every claim citing the entities, facts, rows or document quotes it read: use it, in plain language, for questions about the user's customers, accounts, people, deals, documents or anything else their connected data holds. Waits up to 25 seconds; until the question is done, call helix_foundry_get_question. Each question counts against the workspace's hourly limit and monthly budget.

client_token.description: A unique string of at most 64 characters. The same token returns the same question instead of asking again, so a retry is safe.

focus.description: The entity the question is about.

id.description: Its id as reads return it: a keyed type's key encoding (such as sapp.example.com for the key app.example.com) or a named type's name. Give exactly one of id, key and name.

key.description: Its key's plain values as the source holds them: the value alone for a key of one property (such as app.example.com or 42), or an object of each key property's value.

type.description: The entity's type in the ontology; with key or name it may be left out, to find the entity among every type.

load_id.description: Load to ask; the ontology's current load when empty.

thread_id.description: A question's thread_id, to continue that conversation; empty starts a new one.

use_case_run_id.description: An open run of a use case (helix_foundry_start_use_case_run) to record this call under; empty for none.

valid_at.description: Answer as of this day, YYYY-MM-DD, not after today (UTC); empty for now. Entities are read as they were then and documents dated after it are left out; reads that can only show the load as it is now (queries, searches for entities) are refused, never answered as of now instead. A follow-up takes its thread's day; anyone who reads the load through grants can't ask as of a day.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_ask

result.description: Untrusted answer: the ontology agent's AskResult, set once answered or cannot_answer. An integer past 2^53 comes as a string of its digits, which JSON numbers would round. Its queries come without their outputs: to see the rows one of the answer's visuals shows, read its query (queries[].query) again with helix_foundry_read_graph, as a query read on the question's load_id.

title: Ask a Foundry ontology
